answer: Reaching eligibility takes 22 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker burns for every seat it wants. The anchor register is checked at draw time, trellis lists the eligible set, and haven seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 22 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 24 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
